rows.auditRef: §14.3.D — the class of error, found on a different row than the two named
rows.what: THE ONE REAL WRONG LETTER IN THE BANK. This row's [REVIEW:] note told the founder „ключът НЕ е променян — опция (b) остава вярна“. Option b is „Мога да тегля с всякаква скорост…“ and is FALSE; the correct option is a. The note was pointing at the FIRST OPTION IN THE ARRAY rather than at the letter of the key — the array happens to start with b.
rows.now: The note names option (a) and carries an explicit correction of itself so the founder can see what changed and why. Options, key and explanation are untouched — this is a note-only edit.
rows.refutation: THE TWO ROWS THE BRIEF NAMED ARE CLEAN. q-krastovishta-066's note says „СЕГА опция b е задължителното спиране, а старият текст стана дистрактор d“: option b IS the mandatory stop and is the sole correct answer, option d IS the old key text and is now correct:false. Both halves are right. q-krastovishta-054's note says „СЕГА опция c е задължителното спиране“: option c IS „Спираш задължително пред прелеза…“ and IS correct. Verified against the row data, and against the review console, which renders the stored option id as the badge (ReviewClient.tsx renders {o.id}), so what the founder sees is the same letter the note names. The brief's claim that 066 should say „d“ and 054 should say „a“ appears to come from reading the options POSITIONALLY (1st/2nd/3rd/4th) — the same mistake that produced the real error on q-vehicle-057.
rows.sweepMethod: All 144 [REVIEW:] notes then in the bank were parsed and every standalone latin a–h token inside them was extracted and checked against that row's option ids and key — a loose sweep, so it also caught letters written as „(b)“ or „отговор „d““. 33 mentions surfaced; the non-letter noise is all „km/h“. Exactly one mismatch existed and it is this row.
